config:
config-version: 8
server:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: PORT
management:
  disable-control-panel: true
requests:
  passthrough-headers: true
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTHDIR
api-keys:
  openai-compatibility:
    - name: Acme
      base-url: http://UPSTREAM/v1
      models:
        - name: acme-chat
          alias: chat
      keys:
        - api-key: sk-fake-acme

scenarios.name: compat_status_error
requests:
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: UPSTREAM
User-Agent: cli-proxy-openai-compat
Content-Length: 65
Authorization: Bearer sk-fake-acme
Content-Type: application/json
Accept-Encoding: gzip

{"model":"acme-chat","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}

scenarios.name: compat_stream_status_error
requests:
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: UPSTREAM
User-Agent: cli-proxy-openai-compat
Content-Length: 119
Accept: text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer sk-fake-acme
Cache-Control: no-cache
Content-Type: application/json
Accept-Encoding: gzip

{"model":"acme-chat","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}

scenarios.name: compat_stream_empty
requests:
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: UPSTREAM
User-Agent: cli-proxy-openai-compat
Content-Length: 119
Accept: text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer sk-fake-acme
Cache-Control: no-cache
Content-Type: application/json
Accept-Encoding: gzip

{"model":"acme-chat","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}
